cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Choose the Relationship
cards.instruction: Make someone prioritize this connection over a competing person, promise, or opportunity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Dinner's at seven. I've learned your mother's dumplings, and tonight we're eating together instead of going to that networking dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The director's coming. I could get promoted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll eat at six. I'll do the clearing up; you can wear the suit. But give this evening to us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Freeze them. We'll have them tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That was the anniversary plan too. I'll freeze the leftovers, but put two on plates now. Call and say you're having dinner with me. We can eat quickly; I need you to choose being here, not just another date for the dumplings.

reason: Have A preserve command of dinner while offering earlier time and all cleanup, then distinguish freezing food from repeatedly deferring the connection.
